isd.text: Edgar Markov, prodded by the demon Shilgengar to experiment with blood during a famine, traps the angel Marycz with his sons and exsanguinates her, creating the ritual of vampirism on Innistrad.
He then forces his grandson Sorin to turn, and the trauma ignites Sorin's planeswalker spark, so Sorin leaves the plane.

Sorin later finds vampires pushing humanity toward extinction and acts on his own after Edgar dismisses his concerns, and he musters the surviving Markov vampires to retake Edgar's manor, where Edgar survives and later marries Olivia Voldaren.

vow.text: Edgar Markov, who six millennia earlier dismissed Sorin's warning that vampires will drink Innistrad dry, is stolen from his mausoleum by Olivia Voldaren, who wakes him with her blood and proposes, and he agrees to marry her.

Olivia plans to control Innistrad's angels with Sigarda's blood, and when Sorin crashes the wedding and Katilda frees Sigarda, her fury shatters the hall and Olivia drops the Moonsilver Key and flees with Edgar.

In the sanguitorium Edgar breaks Sorin's wrist and throws him into a vat, insisting Sorin has squandered his gift, but the empowered Sorin returns and defeats him, shows him mercy and tells him to get out of his sight.
Arlinn and her wolves later corner Olivia and Edgar, who escape through a broken window.
